_README: Wallets to copy-trade. Edit this file, not config.json. Reloaded at startup.

_schema.name: Yours. Display only, safe to rename.
_schema.address: Immutable primary key; per-wallet stats key on this.
_schema.chains: which chains to watch this address on. EVM addresses are valid on every EVM chain.
_schema.enabled: false keeps the record without subscribing

wallets.name: @trader_one (solana)
wallets._disabledReason: Solana out of scope: Alchemy has no Solana WSS, so re-enabling needs a second provider such as Helius.
